Set the warning time per hold (default 24 h). Given a tentative hold on a venue for an event I coordinate, when I set a warning time for that hold (for example 24 hours before it expires), then it is saved against that hold; a new hold starts at 24 hours until I change it.

Warning shown when expiry is near. Given "Orchid Hall" is held for "Summit A", which I coordinate, expiring 2026-11-01 17:00, and the time is 2026-11-01 09:00 (inside the hold's warning window), when I open my venue booking requests, then the hold shows "Hold expires in 8 hours".

No warning while expiry is still far off. Given the same hold and the time is 2026-10-30 09:00 (outside its warning window), when I open my venue booking requests, then no expiry warning is shown (and none is written).

Notified once when the warning time is reached. Given the warning time has been reached and the hold is still unconfirmed, then I receive one in-app notification saying the hold on "Orchid Hall" for "Summit A" expires in N hours; later checks do not write it again.

Expired hold is flagged in the list and notified once. Given the hold expired at 2026-11-01 17:00 unconfirmed, when I open my venue booking requests, then "Orchid Hall" shows "Hold expired, venue no longer reserved", and I received one notification that it expired, the venue is no longer reserved and I must submit a new request.
Confirmation clears the warning and stops notifications. Given a hold that showed a warning, when it is confirmed before expiry, then no warning is shown and no further notification is sent.

Only the event's coordinator is warned or notified. Given "Summit A" is coordinated by someone else, when I open my venue booking requests, then I see no warning about its hold and receive no notification about it.
Expiry changed by Venue Staff. Given Venue Staff change the hold's expiry, then I am notified of the new expiry and the warning is recalculated from it (shared with SCRUM-97's extension scenario).
Given I am signed in as any role, when I query `users` directly for another person's email or phone, then it is refused.

Given I am an organiser, coordinator, Lead, venue staff or technical support staff, when a page shows another person's name (assignee, requester, technician, coordinator), then it still shows the name and no email or phone.

Given I am an organiser or coordinator and I open the registrations of an event I manage, when the list loads, then each attendee's name, email and phone are shown, and only for that event's attendees.
Given I am an attendee (or any role that does not manage the event), when I ask for an event's attendee contact details, then nothing is returned.
Given any role, when I update my own profile (name, phone, communication preferences), then it still works and `role` stays unwritable (migration 03 unchanged).
Given I am signed in, when I try to change, add or delete another person's `users` row through the API, then it is refused.
Given I am signed in as any role, when I read venues, their supported layouts and facilities, equipment, organisations and the lookup tables, then I can, as today.
Given I am not Venue Staff, when I insert, update or delete a venue, a venue's supported layouts or facilities, a room layout type or a facility, then it is refused.
Given I am Venue Staff, when I add, edit or delete a room layout type or a facility, then it works.
Given I am not Technical Support Staff, when I insert, update or delete an `equipment` row, then it is refused.
Given any signed-in user, when I write to `organisations` or `event_categories` through the API, then it is refused.
Given Venue Staff, when I set a venue's setup and turnaround times or mark it unavailable, then those still work through their existing functions (migrations 26, 39, 46).
Given I am a coordinator, when I query `events` directly, then I only get the events assigned to me.
Given I am a coordinator and an event is not assigned to me, when I open it (`GET /events/:id` or its page), then I get a not-found response, not its details.
Given I am a coordinator, when an event is unassigned, then I cannot see it; only Leads see the unassigned queue.
Given an event is reassigned, when the new coordinator opens it, then they can, and the previous coordinator can no longer.
Given I am the assigned coordinator, when I review, comment, change status, edit details or handle a change request, then it all works as before.
Given I am a Lead, Venue Staff, Technical Support Staff, an organiser or an attendee, when I read events, then what I can see is unchanged.
Given an organiser submits an event request, when it is saved, then every active Event Coordinator Lead is notified.
Given Venue Staff approve or reject a venue booking, when the decision is saved, then the event's assigned coordinator is notified, with the reason on a rejection.
Given an important event change is saved, when it commits, then the organiser and the assigned coordinator are notified, except whoever made the change.
Given a registration's status changes, when it commits, then that attendee is notified.
Given an event becomes Confirmed, when it commits, then the organiser and the assigned coordinator are notified.

Given an event becomes Cancelled, when it commits, then the organiser, the assigned coordinator and attendees who pass `receivesEventUpdates()` are notified, with the reason when one was given (W9 r19).
Given a venue's buffer change creates a conflict, when it commits, then the assigned coordinator of each flagged booking is notified (W9 r47).
Given a replacement venue is approved, when it commits, then the organiser and attendees who pass `receivesEventUpdates()` are notified (W9 r52).
Given an attendee has withdrawn, when any of the above happens to the event, then that attendee gets no notification.
Given I am the event's assigned Event Coordinator and the event is not completed, cancelled or rejected, when I cancel it without a reason, then it is refused and nothing changes.
Given I cancel an event with a reason, when the cancellation is saved, then the event is Cancelled and the reason is recorded in its status history.
Given the event has active venue bookings (pending, held or approved), when I cancel it, then every one of them is cancelled, so the venues are free for other requests.
Given the event has equipment requests or reservations, when I cancel it, then they are released, so the units are free for other events.
Given the event has a pending change request, when the event is cancelled or marked completed, then the change request is closed automatically.
Given I cancel an event, when the cancellation is saved, then the Event Organiser and every attendee with an active registration receive a notification with the reason.
Given an event is Cancelled, when anyone tries to change its status or details, then it is refused.
Given I am not the event's assigned Event Coordinator, when I try to cancel it, then it is refused and nothing changes.

Given my event has a pending change request that changes a field (e.g. the date), when I submit another change request that changes any of the same fields, then it is refused with a message saying which field already has a request waiting and that I can ask my coordinator about it, and nothing is saved.
Given my event has a pending change request, when I submit a change request that changes only other fields, then it is accepted as usual.
Given my earlier change request was approved or rejected, when I submit a new request for the same field, then it is accepted.
Given I open the change request form while a request is pending, when the form loads, then it tells me which fields already have a request waiting.
Given I am Venue Staff, when I add a layout type with a name, then it appears in the layout choices when adding or editing a venue.
Given a layout type that venues use, when I rename it, then the new name is shown on the venues that use it.
Given a layout type that no venue uses, when I delete it, then it is removed and disappears from the choices.
Given a layout type that a venue uses, when I try to delete it, then the delete is refused and I am told which venues use it.
Given I enter an empty name, or a name another layout type already has, when I add or rename a layout type, then it is rejected and I am shown the reason.
Given I am not Venue Staff, when I try to add, rename or delete a layout type, then the action is not available to me in the interface and the database refuses it.
Given I am Technical Support Staff, when I add an item with its required details and save, then it appears in the equipment inventory and availability checks.
Given an item exists, when I change its details and save, then the new values show in the inventory.
Given an item is available, when I mark it under maintenance, then it reports no free units in availability checks.
Given I clear a required field, when I save, then it is rejected and I see which field is invalid.
Given I am not Technical Support Staff, when I try to add or edit equipment, then the action is not available and the database refuses it.
